name: Ezilon Regional Directory

sources.title: Submission guidelines — free tier only for non-commercial sites; commercial listings paid (refunded if declined); regional-category routing

conditions: Free listing is restricted to NON-commercial sites: government, NGOs, trade associations, charities, research institutes, schools/universities
Commercial websites (any business/SaaS) pay — 'we will refund payment if listing is declined' confirms a fee; amount not stated on this page
Must submit through a specific regional category (USA, Canada, Europe, UK, Australia, NZ, Asia, Africa, etc.)
requirements: Human-editor review; 'quality website with good contents' only
No under-construction sites, no duplicate/similar content, no redirecting URLs
Site must be in English or have an English version
Site must stay active before and after inclusion
Use a contactable non-free email (they warn against free webmail)
preparation: Correct regional category (submit to the region matching your content/location)
Title, description, keywords for the listing
Payment method if commercial (fee amount revealed in the regional submit flow)
workflow: Pick the matching regional submission link (e.g. USA → search.ezilon.com/united_states/)
Navigate to the right category and use the 'Site Submit' link at top of category
Fill title, description, keywords; commercial listings proceed through payment
Human editors review; payment refunded if declined
watchFor: Old-school directory network (©2011 submission program) — legacy UX, per-region subdomains
A commercial SaaS does NOT qualify for the free tier — don't misclassify
Fee amount isn't shown on the guidelines page — appears inside the regional flow
Reciprocal link explicitly NOT required ('Link is not required!')
They accept multiple sites under one email confirmation
countsAsLive: The site appears on its regional category page in the Ezilon directory and in Ezilon search results
unknowns: Whether the directory still actively publishes (legacy site, unclear velocity)
